metric_definitions.factual_precision: Per-frame weighted mean of distinct candidate claim correctness credits (0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1), displayed times 100.
metric_definitions.required_fact_recall: Per-frame weighted mean coverage credits (same quarter-step scale) over every required approved reference fact, displayed times 100.
metric_definitions.factual_f1: Per-frame harmonic mean of factual_precision and required_fact_recall, on their 0–1 scales, displayed times 100; custom graded factual F-score, not classification F1.
metric_definitions.structure_score: Frozen judge quarter-step structural adherence score, displayed times 100.
metric_definitions.instruction_score: Frozen judge quarter-step instruction adherence score, displayed times 100.
metric_definitions.benchmark_index: 100 * frame_factual_f1 * (0.8 + 0.1 * frame_structure_score + 0.1 * frame_instruction_score); components use 0–1 scales. Compute for each frame then arithmetic mean.
metric_definitions.keywords: Novel factual keyword assertions are assigned a semantic prose home; equivalent repeated propositions are counted once, not as independent keyword facts.

index.aggregation: Mean of per-frame index values on eligible frames; also report recording-balanced means and paired common-frame comparisons. Do not substitute the formula applied to means of component scores.
index.label: Provisional Graded Quality Index (0–100)
index.rationale: Graded factual F1 is the primary summary. The secondary index uses the same provisional 80/10/10 factors: factual F1 multiplied by 0.8 + 0.1 structure + 0.1 instruction. The grade and field-importance scales, anchors and factors require heldout human calibration. Analytic criteria and error severity add no independent deductions.

bootstrap.draw: Uniform sampling with replacement of 25 of the 25 recordings per replicate; all selected frames and model conditions in each sampled recording travel together.
bootstrap.point_estimate: Arithmetic mean of per-frame metric across all 435 frames; composite calculated per frame before averaging.
bootstrap.replicate_estimator: Sum of all sampled recording frame scores divided by their total sampled frame count. No version strata, subset means or fixed subset weights.
bootstrap.inference_scope: Conditional selected-set sensitivity to recording composition, given fixed selected frames, candidate outputs, rubric and one judge realization. Not a calibrated population interval or a model/judge repeatability interval.

scientific_limitations: The 435 frames were manually selected; the benchmark is not a probability sample of deployment behavior.
The 25 recording identifiers are not automatically independent animals; recording-level resampling does not remove any dependence across recordings from the same animal.
Frozen reference approval does not demonstrate human-judge agreement. No verified heldout human calibration establishes this judge or custom grade/field/index weights.
The 42-assessment Codex/Azure pilot covered only three unique frames; those older Codex scores are excluded.
The composite benchmark index is a custom index, not accuracy. The graded factual F-score is not conventional classification F1.
The fresh GPT-4o controlled run does not rescore historical original-model labels and does not validate the manuscript historical 78.6% claim.
Intervals condition on one saved execution and judgment per frame/condition; they omit provider sampling, judge stochasticity, reference uncertainty and unverified animal-level dependence.
Candidate reasoning conditions differ in effort and token caps; generation settings are provided per run rather than interpreted as an isolated randomized effort effect.
